method: Independent RAWS verification against Open-Meteo Previous Runs at true fixed lead. 24h uses explicit HRRR; 48h uses seamless GFS/HRRR because HRRR is short range. Live observations are labels only and never forecast predictors. Metrics include probability calibration, pressure-only and raw-gust baselines, onset/peak timing and exact-zone spatial skill across the five validation stations.
